pages.text: The Queen of the hive guards her dimension with fifty-six cuts of royal meat on the bone. The $(item)Queen's Banquet$() is the polite thing to do with regicide.

pages.title: Fit for a Court
pages.text: Set the banquet at the head of the table and carve four servings for whoever helped — or for yourself, four times, because the Queen did not go quietly.$(p)Pairs well with anything from the $(l:orespawn_delight:the_kitchen/the_cooking_pot)Cooking Pot$() and a locked front door.
